messages:
Mira: Quick UX review — while testing the Routing Policies editor I ran into a few keyboard/a11y friction points and a preview mismatch. Not urgent but want to capture before the next patch. Screenshots attached in thread. Sam: Thanks Mira — can you jot the specific issues so we can triage? Mira: Sure, short list: 1) Focus order: tab stops jump to row actions before the rule title — feels jarring when scanning with keyboard. 2) Reorder handle isn't keyboard-targetable; drag-only. 3) Validation copy for priority collisions says 'invalid' which reads harsh and unclear. 4) Preview simulator truncates rules differently than runtime (token vs char) so tests diverge. 5) Screen reader reads badges as 'badge 1' instead of 'priority 1'. Jon: +1 on focus order. For reordering we prototyped a small "move" popover (up/down) for keyboard users — keeps single-tab entry and then arrow controls. I'll attach the comp. Aria: accessibility nit: suggest aria-roledescription="reorder handle" for the drag affordance and make preview updates aria-live="polite" so SRs announce changes without being noisy. Also prefer role=list / role=listitem for the rule group. Lee: Another keyboard thing — in compact mode the overflow menu is hidden off-screen; keyboard users can’t reach it. Maybe add an always-focusable "More actions" button as a fallback. Sam: For validation copy, propose two variants: A) "Priority collision — this rule shares a priority with another rule. Choose a distinct priority." B) "Priority conflict — please pick a unique priority to avoid ambiguous routing." Which tone do we want? Mira: I like the word "collision" but we should match our product voice (helpful + concise). Suggest: "Priority collision — choose a distinct priority to avoid ambiguous routing." Keep it actionable. Jon: About the preview mismatch — runtime uses the tokenizer and server-side truncation; our local preview used naive char truncation. Short term: add microcopy under preview: "Preview may differ from runtime for very long inputs." Longer term: call the preview endpoint or include the tokenizer. Sam: I'll add both: a microcopy and a backlog ticket to sync preview logic. Also creating an engineering RFC for keyboard reordering patterns so eng-runtime and eng-platform can weigh in. Mira: Quick accessibility checklist I need from design: two comps (compact + expanded) showing keyboard focus states, visible focus styles, and move-popover interaction. Also sample copy for the validation message. Can we review tomorrow 10:00am? @Aria can you validate SR reads after comps? Aria: Yup — will test with NVDA and VoiceOver. Quick code suggestion to help devs: ```html
Match / purchase_amount > 100
``` Make preview changes aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce the simulator update but not every keystroke. Sam: Got it. I'll add these items to the ticket: focus order, keyboard move affordance, validation copy update, preview parity microcopy + backlog, SR labels, overflow keyboard target. @designbot please create INF ticket. designbot: Created INF-8721: "Routing editor — keyboard + a11y fixes and preview parity" — assignees: Sam, Mira; priority: Medium; due: 2024-06-14. Mira: One more visual note — the preview uses green to indicate saved which users interpret as "live/applied". Can we switch to a neutral check + subtle tooltip "saved (applies on deploy)" to avoid implying it's already routing traffic? Lee: Good call. We'll align the visual language — subtle check + neutral color + tooltip. Sam: Thanks all — I'll file design/engineering tasks from INF-8721 and ping eng-runtime for tokenizer parity. Will follow up with the RFC link in a couple hours. :thumbsup: Mira: Thanks team — appreciate the quick feedback. See you at the 10am review.
